import json,hashlib,re
from decimal import Decimal
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from lxml import html
from pathlib import Path
d=json.loads(Path('cpi_review_input.json').read_text())
sources={s['source_id']:s['body'].encode('utf8') for s in d['sources']}
results=[]
for o in d['observations']:
    b=sources[o['source_id']]
    assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==o['source_sha256']
    root=html.fromstring(b)
    tables=root.xpath('//table[@id=$id]',id=o['table_id'])
    assert len(tables)==1
    cells=tables[0].xpath('.//td[@headers=$headers]',headers=o['cell_headers'])
    assert len(cells)==1
    lexeme=' '.join(cells[0].text_content().split())
    assert Decimal(lexeme)==Decimal(o['retained_value'])==Decimal(o['value'])
    row=cells[0].getparent().xpath('./th')
    assert len(row)==1 and ' '.join(row[0].text_content().split())==o['row_label']
    ids=o['cell_headers'].split()
    for node_id,expected in [(ids[1],o['header_group']),(ids[2],o['period_header'])]:
        nodes=tables[0].xpath('.//*[@id=$id]',id=node_id)
        assert len(nodes)==1
        assert re.sub(r'\s+','',' '.join(nodes[0].text_content().split()))==re.sub(r'\s+','',expected)
    cross=o.get('cross_table')
    if cross:
        cc=root.xpath('//table[@id=$id]//td[@headers=$headers]',id=cross['table_id'],headers=cross['cell_headers'])
        assert len(cc)==1 and Decimal(' '.join(cc[0].text_content().split()))==Decimal(lexeme)
    pre=[p.text_content() for p in root.xpath('//pre') if 'Transmission of material' in p.text_content()]
    assert len(pre)==1
    dates=re.findall(r'8:30 a\.m\. \(ET\) (Monday|Tuesday|Wednesday|Thursday|Friday), ([A-Za-z]+ \d{1,2}, \d{4})',pre[0])
    assert len(dates)==1
    dt=datetime.strptime(dates[0][1],'%B %d, %Y').replace(hour=8,minute=30,tzinfo=ZoneInfo('America/New_York'))
    assert dt.strftime('%A')==dates[0][0] and dt.astimezone(timezone.utc)==datetime.fromisoformat(o['published_at'])
    assert o['historical_received_at'] is None and not o['family_accepted']
    results.append({'observation_id':o['observation_id'],'source_sha256':o['source_sha256'],'value_match':True,'labels_match':True,'publication_header_match':True,'cross_table':bool(cross)})
proof={'observations_checked':len(results),'source_count':len(sources),'cross_table_checks':sum(x['cross_table'] for x in results),'errors':0,'checks':results,'scope':'Retained-original values, row/column context and stated publication header; not historical receipt, full-family coverage or provider truth','family_accepted':False,'original_historical_receipt_inferred':False}
Path('cpi_review_proof.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2))
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in proof.items() if k!='checks'}))
